# 0047: Qualify oracle semantics before prompt tuning

Status: accepted
Type: data
Date: 2026-10-25

## Context

0045's headless-failure and HP-15's required-floor revisit triggers fired.
[HP-17](../../evidence/prose-headless/2026-10-25-paired-live/README.md) stopped at
108/140 after a candidate/fixed-positive disagreement. Native/accounting audits
pass. A blind source review finds strict-entailment ambiguity in a positive
paraphrase that strengthens permission after confirmation into only-after.
The candidate's necessary-versus-sole-condition explanation is also unsound.
Neither majority opinion nor a previous model match authenticates an oracle.

## Decision

Keep the run failed, its fixed label and every unexecuted denominator unchanged.
Reject the candidate for adoption. No fresh paid calibration or document study
starts until an independently reviewed semantic/citation floor is frozen.

Within0045's same incubation, implement the bounded offline
[oracle qualification contract](../../designs/prose-oracle-qualification.md):
prepare a complete source-bound control inventory; record declared adjudications;
deterministically refuse missing declared rows/premises and replaced sources.
CUE owns shape; Go owns binding, coverage and refusal. Neither proves that
semantic premises or declared judgments are correct.
This is command-local evidence preparation, not a universal semantic engine.

Cited facts supply positive support; all authoritative exposed facts remain
available to defeat a claim. Exact copying, faithful paraphrase and normative
direction need explicit criteria. Permission, necessary conditions, sufficient
conditions and sole conditions must not silently substitute for each other.
Ambiguous source language remains unresolved under a strict-entailment criterion.

Any future changed label, citation, criterion, prompt or source is a new versioned
floor/study with a complete old-to-new disposition. Preserve every old control and
its measured outcome as historical evidence. A prior ambiguous control may become
a required uncertainty control in a prospective suite; it cannot disappear.
Add explicit modal contrasts and independently audit all controls before spending. Assessor exposure/blinding and identity remain declared evidence,
not something packet validation can authenticate.

All0045/0046 limits remain: same budget and two slots, synthetic inputs, required
long witness, no UI/global install/publication, and separate human/source truth.
No new public library is extracted without a second concrete consumer.

## Decision models

Optional model suggestions may flag ambiguity or propose missing premises. The
deterministic fallback is unresolved/held. Keep a suggestion site only after a
separately frozen comparison measures useful findings, false dismissals and cost;
kill it on a critical missed ambiguity. It cannot affirm its own evaluation floor.

## Alternatives rejected

- Tune prompts until the old label passes: rewards grader agreement over evidence.
  Wins if: never without first qualifying the disputed floor.
- Relabel or resume the failed study: erases the observation and stop contract.
  Wins if: never.
- Use uncited context as silent positive support: conceals incomplete provenance.
  Wins if: an explicit future profile permits it and records the actual premise set.
- Build a general formal-logic or policy engine: not needed to prepare and audit
  this evidence. Wins if: two consumers supply typed semantics and bounded proofs.
- Replace the model with lexical only/after matching: wording cannot prove modality.
  Wins if: the source is an explicit typed contract with deterministic semantics.

## Revisit when

An oracle ambiguity survives preflight, a required negative disappears, declared
adjudication is treated as authenticated truth, a revised floor cannot explain
every old control, or0045's budget/release/2026-11-21 review arrives.
